name: parentheses-after-a-tag-are-refused
expect: "the parentheses after a tag hold code, which a literal does not run: a value computed goes under a tag by `tag`, write `1 | add 2 | tag ::Box`"

name: a-number-in-parentheses-after-a-tag-is-refused
expect: "a number, a boolean, null or a path touches its tag by `#`: write `::Width#5`"

name: a-group-inside-a-literal-is-refused
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get [~(5 | add 1) 2]`"

name: a-name-inside-a-literal-is-refused
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get [~(x)]`"

name: a-literal-that-computes-in-the-code-of-a-doc-is-refused-as-anywhere
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get [~(1 | add 1)]`"

name: an-error-literal-names-the-facts-get-builds
expect: "an error literal computes nothing: facts computed are built by `get` and `raise` makes them an error, write `get {:a ~(1 | add 1)} | raise`"

name: a-map-entry-of-two-values-is-refused-naming-the-template-of-get
expect: "a map entry holds one literal, `{:k 1}`, and a shape computed is built by `get`: `get {:k ~(f x)}`"

name: the-message-of-a-literal-past-a-line-writes-the-parts-that-compute-and-cuts-the-rest
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get [… ~(add 1) …]`"

name: the-message-of-a-literal-within-a-line-writes-the-template-whole
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get [~(5 | add 1) 2]`"

name: the-message-of-an-error-literal-past-a-line-cuts-its-facts-that-compute-nothing
query: "!{:a (1 | add 2) :note \"a long note that runs past the line of the template, written here to fill it\"}" | parse !| message
expect: "an error literal computes nothing: facts computed are built by `get` and `raise` makes them an error, write `get {:a ~(1 | add 2) …} | raise`"

name: the-message-of-a-tagged-literal-past-a-line-writes-its-tag-before-the-cut-payload
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get ::Box[… ~(add 1) …]`"

name: the-message-of-a-map-past-a-line-writes-the-entries-that-compute-under-their-keys
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get {… :l ~(add 1) …}`"

name: the-message-of-a-set-past-a-line-writes-the-parts-that-compute-in-its-order
expect: "a literal computes nothing: a shape computed is built by `get`, its parts paths and quotes, write `get #[… ~(add 1)]`"
